task: The gated PLAN->INIT reopen validates a mandatory reason but never persists it, so the documented claim that the reopen is auditable is not durably true; also correct two overstated code comments flagged by the same review.
outcome: A successful PLAN->INIT reopen leaves an append-only phase_transition process event carrying the verbatim reason and a transitionType=reopen marker, provable by a smoke assertion that reads the persisted JSONL; and two comments state their real guarantees instead of overstating them.
facts: transition-orchestrator.ts validates args.reason (non-blank, >= REOPEN_REASON_MIN=10 chars) at the REOPEN remap, then never reads it again.
buildPhaseTransitionProcessEvent had no reason field and its single call site never passed one.
ProcessEvent is an open record type ({ type, timestamp, [key: string]: unknown }); appendProcessEvent JSON.stringifies it with no schema validation, hashing, or signing.
The phase_transition event is appended only AFTER a successful writeStory, so a failed transition cannot already leave an event claiming success.
No consumer of phase_transition performs key-set validation or full-event equality; done-prepare.ts reads named fields only.
The REOPEN checklist reset and the phase write are two separate fs writes under a mkdir persist claim, ordered so the phase write lands last.
pruneWorktreeRegistry runs `git worktree prune --expire now`, which cannot remove a live sibling worktree but does clear every currently-missing registration repo-wide.
CLI version bump is performed mechanically by bumpVersionOnDoneMerge during the DONE merge; there is no manual version command.
constraints: Normal transitions must keep a byte-identical phase_transition event shape so the flow-stability builder deepEqual test and all existing consumers stay green.
The two comment corrections must not be folded into the behavioral commit (explicit user directive), so a documentation nit cannot block the audit fix.
No forged or manufactured dispatch/review evidence; Proof-or-Stop requires mechanical evidence only.
Scope excludes actor/eventId provenance plumbing and any crash-transactionality hardening (recorded in scope-boundary.json as excluded).
Story branches stay local; no remote push.
